 1658 # OnBeingHit handlers
 1659 #===============================================================================

 1661 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:AFTERMATH,
 1662   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1663     next if !target.fainted?
 1664     next if !move.pbContactMove?(user)
 1665     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1666     if !battle.moldBreaker
 1667       dampBattler = battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DAMP)
 1668       if dampBattler
 1669         battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(dampBattler)
 1670         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1671           battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cannot use {2}!", target.pbThis, target.abilityName))
 1672         else
 1673           battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cannot use {2} because of {3}'s {4}!",
 1674              target.pbThis, target.abilityName, dampBattler.pbThis(true), dampBattler.abilityName))
 1675         end
 1676         battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(dampBattler)
 1677         battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1678         next
 1679       end
 1680     end
 1681     if user.takesIndirectDamage?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH) &&
 1682        user.affectedByContactEffect?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1683       battle.scene.pbDamageAnimation(user)
 1684       user.pbReduceHP(user.totalhp / 4, false)
 1685       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was caught in the aftermath!", user.pbThis))
 1686     end
 1687     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1688   }
 1689 )

 1691 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:ANGERPOINT,
 1692   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1693     next if !target.damageState.critical
 1694     next if !target.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(:ATTACK, target)
 1695     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1696     target.stages[:ATTACK] = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
 1697     target.statsRaisedThisRound = true
 1698     battle.pbCommonAnimation("StatUp", target)
 1699     if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1700       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} maxed its {2}!", target.pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(:ATTACK).name))
 1701     else
 1702       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} maxed its {3}!",
 1703          target.pbThis, target.abilityName, GameData::Stat.get(:ATTACK).name))
 1704     end
 1705     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1706   }
 1707 )

 1709 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:COTTONDOWN,
 1710   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1711     next if battle.allBattlers.none? { |b| b.index != target.index && b.pbCanLowerStatStage?(:SPEED, target) }
 1712     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1713     battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
 1714       b.pbLowerStatStageByAbility(:SPEED, 1, target, false) if b.index != target.index
 1715     end
 1716     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1717   }
 1718 )

 1720 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:CURSEDBODY,
 1721   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1722     next if user.fainted?
 1723     next if user.effects[PBEffects::Disable] > 0
 1724     regularMove = nil
 1725     user.eachMove do |m|
 1726       next if m.id != user.lastRegularMoveUsed
 1727       regularMove = m
 1728       break
 1729     end
 1730     next if !regularMove || (regularMove.pp == 0 && regularMove.total_pp > 0)
 1731     next if battle.pbRandom(100) >= 30
 1732     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1733     if !move.pbMoveFailedAromaVeil?(target, user, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1734       user.effects[PBEffects::Disable]     = 3
 1735       user.effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] = regularMove.id
 1736       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1737         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} was disabled!", user.pbThis, regularMove.name))
 1738       else
 1739         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} was disabled by {3}'s {4}!",
 1740            user.pbThis, regularMove.name, target.pbThis(true), target.abilityName))
 1741       end
 1742       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1743       user.pbItemStatusCureCheck
 1744     end
 1745     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1746   }
 1747 )

 1749 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:CUTECHARM,
 1750   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1751     next if target.fainted?
 1752     next if !move.pbContactMove?(user)
 1753     next if battle.pbRandom(100) >= 30
 1754     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1755     if user.pbCanAttract?(target, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH) &&
 1756        user.affectedByContactEffect?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1757       msg = nil
 1758       if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1759         msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} fall in love!", target.pbThis,
 1760            target.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
 1761       end
 1762       user.pbAttract(target, msg)
 1763     end
 1764     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)

 1768 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit.add(:EFFECTSPORE,
 1769   proc { |ability, user, target, move, battle|
 1770     # NOTE: This ability has a 30% chance of triggering, not a 30% chance of
 1771     #       inflicting a status condition. It can try (and fail) to inflict a
 1772     #       status condition that the user is immune to.
 1773     next if !move.pbContactMove?(user)
 1774     next if battle.pbRandom(100) >= 30
 1775     r = battle.pbRandom(3)
 1776     next if r == 0 && user.asleep?
 1777     next if r == 1 && user.poisoned?
 1778     next if r == 2 && user.paralyzed?
 1779     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
 1780     if user.affectedByPowder?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH) &&
 1781        user.affectedByContactEffect?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1782       case r
 1783       when 0
 1784         if user.pbCanSleep?(target, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1785           msg = nil
 1786           if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1787             msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} fall asleep!", target.pbThis,
 1788                target.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
 1789           end
 1790           user.pbSleep(msg)
 1791         end
 1792       when 1
 1793         if user.pbCanPoison?(target, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1794           msg = nil
 1795           if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1796             msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} poisoned {3}!", target.pbThis,
 1797                target.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
 1798           end
 1799           user.pbPoison(target, msg)
 1800         end
 1801       when 2
 1802         if user.pbCanParalyze?(target, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
 1803           msg = nil
 1804           if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1805             msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} paralyzed {3}! It may be unable to move!",
 1806                target.pbThis, target.abilityName, user.pbThis(true))
 1807           end
 1808           user.pbParalyze(target, msg)
 1809         end
 1810       end
 1811     end
 1812     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
 1813   }
 1814 )
